reason: D10: semantic ranks with TF-IDF only; the command list describes it so instead of fastembed with a TF-IDF fallback. Python's argparse took prog from the invoked script (tools/<tool>.py); the Go binaries are run as their installed command (tools/install.sh), so usage and help name that command, not a retired .py script.

usage: cnav [-h] [--version] <command> ...

Navigate the niagara-research knowledge corpus (blocks, docs, retros).

positional arguments:
  <command>
    find             full-text case-insensitive tokenized search with ranking
    grep             regex (re module) search
    show             H1 + outline + Connections of block B<N>
    list             list all blocks (from CATALOG.md)
    by-marker        blocks containing an evidence marker
    by-focus         blocks belonging to a focus
    connections      forward + reverse block links for B<N>
    graph            whole citation graph (summary, or --json adjacency)
    path             shortest citation chain between two blocks
    lint-refs        flag non-canonical citations (exit 1 if any)
    stats            corpus totals + marker counts
    selftest         assert core search behaviours (exits non-zero on failure)
    semantic (rank)  rank blocks by TF-IDF similarity to a query

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --version          print the tools version and exit
